remarks: Imagine coming home to Tamarackmills after a long day downtown. This split-bedroom layout gives you and a roommate or guest plenty of privacy, with newer flooring and windows throughout. The building even has guest suites for visitors. A great fit for young professionals. You'll love the easy commute.

A 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom detached home on a generous 43 x 148 ft lot on Cypress Crescent in Juniperheights, offered as-is. The roof and windows are near the end of their life, and the interior needs attention throughout, but the primary bedroom is large with a walk-in closet. The 2-storey layout offers 1,700-1,899 sq ft of space for a small family to reimagine. A library and cafes are close by. The 2-car driveway provides ample parking.

Picture yourself on a winter morning, coffee in hand, watching the snow fall over the ravine from your living room window. This 3-bed, 3-bath condo on Balsam Crescent has an unobstructed view that's pure magic. The catch? It needs a full cosmetic overhaul—the finishes are tired, the paint is dated, and it's offered as-is. For a couple starting out with vision, this is a blank slate in a great building. You get three parking spots and a chance to create your dream space from the studs up. The ravine trails are right there, ready for weekend adventures. Roll up your sleeves and make it yours.

Experience luxury in this stunning, fully redone loft! The custom kitchen shines with quartz counters and an expansive island, while the spa-like baths feature frameless glass showers. Enjoy pot lights throughout and concierge service for added convenience. Located in Elmview, you’re near beautiful parks and ravine trails. This is the perfect home for a growing family!

Discover this spacious three-bedroom condo with a split-bedroom layout! The offered as-is condition means you can personalize it to your taste. While older appliances may need replacing, the generous living space is perfect for family life. A community centre nearby provides engaging activities for all ages. Your fresh start awaits!
